species.name: Crappie
why: Water 57°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–16 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 60 ft, so fish stay above it.
